subject: Clarifications needed: Machine Learning Engineer (Alicia Torres) — scores, ambiguous feedback, next steps
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Clarifications needed: Machine Learning Engineer (Alicia Torres) — scores, ambiguous feedback, next steps

Hi all,

Thanks for taking the time to interview Alicia yesterday. I pulled the scorecards and attached a consolidated PDF that highlights where feedback diverges most heavily. Two quick asks so we can wrap this up by EOD Wednesday: 

- Can each interviewer add a 1-sentence clarifier for any score 2 or lower (what specifically led to that rating)?
- If you believe a follow-up (technical coding or architecture follow-up) will materially change hire/no-hire, say so explicitly and suggest duration (30/60/90 min).

Key areas of ambiguity in the consolidated view: system design (several comments are high-level praise vs concrete tradeoffs) and coding (one reviewer says "rough implementation" but doesn't say which test case failed).

I've flagged the relevant pages in the PDF. Attaching Alicia's resume again for quick reference. If we can get the clarifiers by EOD Tuesday I'll synthesize and call for a final vote.

Thanks,
Mina

Mina Haddad
Hiring Manager, Applied ML
Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com

Attachments: Alicia_Torres_consolidated_scorecard.pdf (PDF, 420KB); resume_alicia_torres.pdf (PDF, 210KB)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 10:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarifications needed: Machine Learning Engineer (Alicia Torres) — scores, ambiguous feedback, next steps

Thanks Mina — quick clarifiers from my side below (happy to expand):

- System design (score: 3): Candidate sketched a reasonable streaming KV cache approach but didn't justify memory vs latency tradeoff for sharded models. Concern: no explicit plan for cold-start KV eviction.
- Coding (score: 2): During the whiteboard, their solution passed basic cases but missed an off-by-one in the rolling-window logic (I noted which test input failed: sequence length boundary at 0 vs 1). With a 30-min follow-up coding exercise they'd likely fix this.

Recommendation: Schedule a 30-min focused coding check (rolling-window edge cases) and a 30-min architecture clarifier if Marcus thinks design gaps are material.

-Laura

Laura Bennett
Senior Staff ML Engineer
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 11:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarifications needed: Machine Learning Engineer (Alicia Torres) — scores, ambiguous feedback, next steps

Short version from me:

- System design (score: 3): I liked the high-level approach but it lacked concrete throughput numbers or ops/sec assumptions. If we make that explicit and ask the candidate to reason about a 100k tokens/sec workload, I think we get the clarity we need.
- Culture/ownership (score: 4): Strong signal — would be fine working with them.

Given the team is split on architecture, I support a 30-minute architecture follow-up with a clear prompt: "design for 100k tokens/sec, discuss KV eviction and multi-tenant impact". If they answer that confidently, I'm fine moving forward.

Marcus

Marcus Lin
Staff Engineer, Serving Runtime
marcus_lin@redwood.com

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarifications needed: Machine Learning Engineer (Alicia Torres) — scores, ambiguous feedback, next steps

Adding my two cents and numeric breakdown (so Mina can easily synthesize):

- Coding: 3 — generally correct but missed performance corner case (30-min coding exercise should clear this).
- Design: 2 — explanation lacked tradeoffs; I'd like a 30-min redo focused on eviction and multi-tenant QoS.
- Culture/communication: 4 — clear communicator and aligns with team values.

If we do both 30-min follow-ups (one coding, one design), that feels like a lot. My preference: do a single 45-min architecture + one targeted coding question at the end (10-15 min) to validate the implementation detail.

Tessa

Tessa Morgan
Engineering Manager, Platform
tessa_morgan@redwood.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Ben Holt (Recruiter) <ben.holt@talentlink.io>, Alicia Torres <alicia.torres@gmail.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up ask: 45-min clarifying loop (architecture + short coding) — Alicia Torres

Hi Ben / Alicia,

Thanks again for interviewing with us. The interview team has a few focused clarifying items we'd like to cover to finalize feedback. Would Alicia be available for a 45-minute follow-up that covers architecture (30 min) and a brief coding/edge-case discussion (10-15 min)? Our availability windows: Wednesday 6/16 between 10:00–12:30 PT or Thursday 6/17 between 13:00–16:00 PT.

Ben: if that works, please confirm a time and I'll send a calendar invite with the prompt (we'll ask Alicia to prepare a 5-minute sketch for the architecture portion: "design a KV caching approach for an LLM serving runtime at 100k tokens/sec, include eviction and multi-tenant considerations").

Alicia: no need for heavy prep — the sketch can be a simple diagram/notes. If you prefer a shorter session, tell us and we can adjust.

Best,
Mina

From: Ben Holt (Recruiter) <ben.holt@talentlink.io>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Alicia Torres <alicia.torres@gmail.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 15:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up ask: 45-min clarifying loop (architecture + short coding) — Alicia Torres

Hi Mina / team — Alicia is available Thursday 6/17 at 13:30 PT. I've tentatively booked a 45-minute slot and sent a calendar invite to all. Alicia appreciates the clear prompt and is okay with the short coding check at the end.

Alicia — thanks for accommodating. We'll confirm afterwards and share any updates or changes to the scorecard.

Ben
Talent Partner | TalentLink
ben.holt@talentlink.io
